name: Mihara (Hiroshima, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Mihara city emblem in light blue, green and blue: light blue, green and blue curved strokes with small discs, like a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Mihara, a city in Hiroshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 2005.

features.role: Mihara city emblem — light blue, green and blue curved strokes with small discs, like a stylised character
